expression_restriction.value: natural expression, face turned directly toward camera

glasses_policy.value: dark glasses and reflective lenses prohibited

face_visibility.value: face must be turned directly toward camera, both eyes visible

headwear_policy.value: not permitted; exception for religious or health reasons

size.evidence: The Icelandic regulation 560/2009 (fetched from island.is/reglugerdir/nr/0560-2009) explicitly states 'tveimur ljósmyndum á ljósmyndapappír 35 x 45 mm að stærð' (two photos on photographic paper 35 x 45 mm in size) in Article 8. Multiple independent third-party sources (visafoto.com, mybiometricphotos.com, timpson.co.uk, passportphotonow.com) all consistently confirm 35 x 45 mm for Iceland passport photos. Iceland follows ICAO standards which specify this size.
